description.value: Yonni's Doughnuts is a scratch-made specialty doughnut bakery on Discovery Street in Victoria, operating as part of the Discovery Coffee family. Every morning the team hand-crafts doughnuts from original recipes using quality ingredients — no mixes, no artificial flavours — producing classics like old-fashioneds, crullers, and fritters alongside seasonal specials and a growing vegan lineup. Cyclists can place online pickup orders or stop by the bakery door directly to collect a fresh box.
